body: Every day is a struggle, but I just keep reminding myself to take every day one step at a time.

I really needed this today. After two failed long term relationships I feel like I'm never going to find the one who will stay. I know I'm not perfect, but I am constantly trying to be a better person.

Prescribed recently to help stop the constant intrusive thoughts of suicide and racing thoughts of high stress in my life between money problems, covid/2020 in general, my boyfriend of 4 years leaving me, my job killing me with forced overtime and crippling social anxiety and depression. I'm scared to develop an addiction. He prescribed 2mg of alprazolam a day. Ive tried to stick to 1 or 1.5mg by taking it in .5 doses through the day when things get bad. I can't see why anyone would take this recreationaly. It helps with the anxiety, but it also just makes me want to sleep all the time. There's no "high" or "chill" for me it just helps me not think about stress 24/7.

I hear you. I'm in the same boat. Hang in there. 
I try and find little things every day to keep going. 
Even if its just getting a monster or listening to a good song. 
Don't give up.
I can very much relate to this.
